rv.q: The central, nerdy, figure of Seymour (Colin Ryan) as the florist’s assistant who feeds the alien plant, does bring the comic spirit, and has a good singing voice, but his romance with Audrey never quite gels. The singing trio that functions as a doo-wop and Motown chorus, narrating or reflecting on the story, bring a strong sound too.

The film was written, rehearsed and shot in two and a half days. One of the fans of the movie was Howard Ashman, who decided some 22 years later to write the book and lyrics for the musical, and Alan Menken came in to compose the score. The strength in this current production lies in its tremendous cast who are universally talented.
